metadata.title: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications 문제은행
metadata.source: Jeppesen Airway Manual, Enroute Data - General, Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications, pp.309–310
metadata.scope_note: p.309–310 only; begins after Oceanic Long-Range Navigation Information.

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: Jeppesen 원문에 따른 ATS route 기본 designator의 문자/숫자 길이 설명으로 맞는 것은?

choices.text: 최대 5개의 alpha/numeric characters이며, 어떠한 경우에도 6개를 초과하지 않는다.

questions.explanation: 원문은 ATS route basic designator가 automation systems에서 사용 가능하도록 maximum of five, in no case exceed six alpha/numeric characters로 구성된다고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: ATS route의 basic designator 구성으로 맞는 것은?
questions.explanation: Basic designator는 one letter of the alphabet followed by a number from 1 to 999로 구성된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: Regional network의 일부이면서 area navigation route가 아닌 ATS route에 사용하는 기본 문자군은?
questions.explanation: Jeppesen 원문은 A, B, G, R을 regional networks의 일부이며 area navigation routes가 아닌 route에 사용한다고 명시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: Regional network의 일부인 area navigation route에 사용하는 기본 문자군은?
questions.explanation: L, M, N, P는 area navigation routes which form part of the regional networks of ATS routes에 사용한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: Regional network의 일부가 아니며 area navigation route도 아닌 ATS route에 사용하는 기본 문자군은?
questions.explanation: H, J, V, W는 regional networks의 일부가 아니며 area navigation routes도 아닌 route에 사용한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: Regional network의 일부가 아닌 area navigation route에 사용하는 기본 문자군은?
questions.explanation: Q, T, Y, Z는 area navigation routes which do not form part of the regional networks of ATS routes에 사용한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: Basic designator가 L로 시작하는 ATS route에 대해 Jeppesen의 문자군 분류상 맞는 설명은?

choices.text: Regional network의 일부인 area navigation route
Regional network의 일부가 아닌 non-RNAV route

questions.explanation: L은 M, N, P와 함께 regional network의 일부인 area navigation route용 기본 문자군에 속한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: Basic designator가 Z로 시작하는 ATS route에 대해 Jeppesen의 문자군 분류상 맞는 설명은?

choices.text: Regional network의 일부가 아닌 RNAV route
Regional network의 일부가 아닌 non-RNAV route

questions.explanation: Z는 Q, T, Y와 함께 regional networks의 일부가 아닌 area navigation route용 문자군에 속한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: ATS route basic designator 앞에 prefix K를 붙이는 의미는?
questions.explanation: Prefix K는 a low level route established for use primarily by helicopters를 나타낸다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: ATS route basic designator 앞에 prefix U를 붙이는 의미는?

choices.text: route 또는 그 일부가 upper airspace에 설정됨

questions.explanation: Prefix U는 route or portion thereof is established in the upper airspace임을 나타낸다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: ATS route basic designator 앞에 prefix S를 붙이는 의미는?

choices.text: Supersonic aircraft가 acceleration/deceleration 및 supersonic flight 중 독점적으로 사용하는 route

questions.explanation: Prefix S는 supersonic aircraft가 acceleration/deceleration 및 supersonic flight 중 exclusively 사용하는 route를 나타낸다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: ATS route basic designator 뒤에 suffix F를 붙이는 의미는?
questions.explanation: Suffix F는 on the route or portion thereof advisory service only is provided임을 나타낸다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: ATS route basic designator 뒤에 suffix G를 붙이는 의미는?
questions.explanation: Suffix G는 on the route or portion thereof flight information service only is provided임을 나타낸다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: Voice communications에서 ATS route basic designator의 기본 문자는 어떻게 발음해야 하는가?
questions.explanation: Jeppesen 원문은 voice communications에서 basic letter of a designator를 ICAO spelling alphabet에 따라 말하도록 한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.309

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: Voice communications에서 prefix K, U, S의 발음 조합으로 맞는 것은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 prefix K, U, S를 voice communications에서 각각 "Kopter", "Upper", "Supersonic"으로 발음한다고 명시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.310

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications
questions.question: ATS route suffix F 또는 G를 voice communications에서 사용하는 것에 대한 Jeppesen 설명은?

choices.text: Flight crew가 이를 사용하도록 요구되지 않는다.
항상 매 교신마다 반드시 발음해야 한다.
G만 생략 가능하고 F는 반드시 발음한다.

questions.explanation: Jeppesen 원문은 suffix F 또는 G가 사용된 경우 flight crew should not be required to use them in voice communications라고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Enroute Data - General · Designators of ATS Routes and Its Use in Voice Communications p.310
